caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure dressed in traditional, colorful clothing, situated on a simple, trapezoidal pedestal. The man wears a red and gold turban with a light-colored circular ornament on the front. His facial features include a large dark mustache, and he has a stern expression. He is dressed in a long red robe or coat with golden-yellow trim and deep red, billowy trousers. His sash or belt is yellow, and his vest is light blue-gray with gold trim. He is also wearing black boots, and his left hand is outstretched with the palm up, while his right hand is clenched into a fist and positioned near his chest. There is a thin rod or cane supporting the figure from the left side extending under his left arm to the ground. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The overall color composition consists mainly of warm hues such as reds, golds, and browns, with some darker accents in the boots, hair, and mustache.
